description: Call one of the user's deployed agent-tool workflows (those with an MCP Tool trigger) by its tool name or workflow id, with the arguments its schema declares. Use it when the workflow is not in your tool list: one deployed since you connected only appears there after you reconnect, but is callable here at once. It runs for real in the user's Cloudflare account and counts toward this connection's daily limit on workflow calls. list_deployed_tools shows what is callable and the arguments each takes.

arguments.description: Arguments matching that tool's schema, from list_deployed_tools.

name.description: The tool name from the workflow's MCP Tool trigger, or the workflow id.

name: call_deployed_workflow
title: Call deployed workflow
